description: Phase C fabric completion (ROADMAP.md Phase C; docs/capability-bus.md §"Not yet built"). Today the knowledge ports surface only `describe` (the manifest) and `invoke` (the built endpoints); `subscribe` exists only for the finetune telemetry stream. Add the KGP `subscribe` / `fetch` verbs for the knowledge ports so a fabric peer can pull a knowledge slice (`fetch`) and receive KGP §6 delta subscriptions (`subscribe`) as the grounding-pack work needs. Implement against koine's KGP contract — do not re-specify it. Scope: the capability-bus / KCB surface (services/api/src/pinakes/routers/capability_bus.py, kcb/mcp.py) + the manifest (contracts/capability-manifest) + tests. Serializes with the other Phase-C rows on the `capability-bus` domain.

userStories.title: KGP fetch for the knowledge ports
userStories.description: Add the KGP fetch verb so a peer can pull a bounded knowledge slice from a knowledge port, per koine's KGP contract.
acceptanceCriteria: The knowledge ports expose a KGP `fetch` verb (alongside describe/invoke) that returns a bounded knowledge slice, implemented against koine's KGP contract (contracts/capability-manifest advertises the verb).
The applicable gates pass: `uv run --all-packages pytest services/api/tests`, `uv run --all-packages ruff check services/api`, `uv run --directory services/api --all-packages mypy`.
`bun run check:contracts` passes (bindings regenerated, no drift) since the manifest/contract source changed.

userStories.title: KGP subscribe (delta subscriptions) for the knowledge ports
userStories.description: Add the KGP subscribe verb (KGP §6 delta subscriptions) to the knowledge ports, generalizing beyond the finetune-only telemetry subscribe that exists today.
acceptanceCriteria: The knowledge ports expose a KGP `subscribe` verb delivering KGP §6 deltas, distinct from the existing finetune telemetry stream; the manifest advertises it and it is exercised by a test.
A test asserts a subscriber receives deltas for a changed knowledge slice (not just a static describe), and the MCP tool surface (kcb/mcp.py) reflects the new verbs.
`.chief/verify.sh` passes; the capability-manifest JSON parses and `bun run check:registry-mirror` passes if a registry-shaped file changed.
